title: Fourth-moment bound for the uniform interval measure
statement: Let $\mu$ be Lebesgue measure conditioned on $[-1,1]$. For the identity random variable $X(x)=x$, its fourth moment under $\mu$ is at most $\frac95$ times the square of its second moment: $\int x^4\,d\mu(x)\leq\frac95\left(\int x^2\,d\mu(x)\right)^2$.
